name: VCC 1895 (Hubble)
blurb: VCC 1895, a dwarf elliptical galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: vcc1895-hubble
story: A dwarf galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, one of 100 early-type galaxies in a Hubble survey that set out to learn how such galaxies form and evolve.

claims.text: VCC 1895 is also UGC 7854, morphological type d:E6
dE-type galaxies in the sample are dwarfs (dwarf ellipticals)
The ACS Virgo Cluster Survey imaged 100 early-type galaxies that are confirmed Virgo Cluster members
The survey aims to understand how early-type galaxies form and evolve
